doc_title_en: Notice of Revision of Consolidated Business Forecasts and Year-End Dividend Forecast for FY12/26 (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 2026年12月期連結業績予想および期末配当予想の修正(増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 連結業績予想の上方修正に伴い、配当方針（配当性向50%程度）に基づき決定

summary_en: Annual dividend raised ¥60.00 → ¥72.00/share (20% increase). Year-end dividend raised ¥30.00 → ¥42.00/share. FY12/26 payout ratio forecast 50.0%, DOE 9.3%. Follows upward revision of consolidated earnings (net profit +13.6%).
summary_jp: 年間配当 ¥60.00 → ¥72.00/株（20%増配）。期末配当 ¥30.00 → ¥42.00/株。配当性向50.0%、株主資本配当率9.3%予想。連結純利益上方修正（+13.6%）に伴い実施。
tag_en: Dividend hike — ¥72.00/share annual (¥60.00 → ¥72.00) — FY12/26 — 50.0% payout ratio
